title: Inside the Ebola Epicenter, the Virus Rages With Little to Stop It
partialText: A remote gold mining town is under siege, as medical workers struggle to beat back a surge of deaths and infections.

title: Judge Reopens Trump’s Lawsuit Demanding $10 Billion From IRS
partialText: The ruling was a blow to both President Trump, who had voluntarily dismissed the suit last week, and to the Justice Department, which used the suit to establish a fund likely intended for Trump allies.

title: Kennedy Center Must Remove Trump’s Name From Building, Judge Orders

title: Among Mamdani’s Priorities, Economic Development Seems Low on the List
partialText: Mayor Zohran Mamdani has not filled the vacant role of president of the Economic Development Corporation, deepening concern over his attention to the New York City economy.

partialText: One super PAC is allied with Anthropic. The other is tied to OpenAI. They’re both spending millions to influence this year’s elections.

partialText: Dr. Adam Hamawy, a New Jersey Democrat with big-name support on the left, has touted his humanitarian work, but some opponents want to talk about Sheikh Omar Abdel Rahman.

title: Iran’s Hard-Liners Try to Derail Potential Deal With the U.S.

partialText: From Iran to Gaza, Eid al-Adha celebrations were muted as war dragged on and shortages of food and fuel roiled the region.

title: Ye and Travis Scott Concerts Canceled in Italy Over Security Fears
partialText: The events were canceled “to ensure public order and safety,” the authorities said. Jewish leaders had objected to the concert by Ye, formerly known as Kanye West, who has a history of antisemitic remarks.
